_comment: Download-lane retry policy (spec Parts 02/03 failure handling). Kept intentionally consistent with verification_rules.json:retry_policy so the two lanes never disagree: the VERIFICATION engine's recovery ladder uses verification_rules.retry_policy; the DOWNLOADER's network-level attempts use this file. Same max/backoff values on both sides.

network_attempts._comment: HTTP-level retry for a single fetch attempt before it is handed to the verification recovery ladder.
